sources.title: NAMD 3 replica exchange
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷
related.titleEn: CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：雙事件驗證公式與標籤；長程採樣品質仍須獨立證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The two events validate arithmetic and labels; long-run sampling quality still needs independent evidence.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付殘差歷程、停止原因表、能量與缺陷對照以及續算決策紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Investigate CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver residual histories, stopping-reason tables, energy-versus-defect comparisons and a restart decision explaining which downstream quantities remain unqualified when electronic convergence fails.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算 exp(−1)，在零到一的線上標記接受區間與 u=0.5；將機率與一次事件分開記錄。
逐項乘 0.2，計算 e6 並與 1e−5 比較；以相鄰缺陷之比重新估計 q，交由另一人核算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate exp(-1), mark its acceptance interval on a unit line and place u=0.5 on the same line. Record the probability separately from the realized decision so that one event is not confused with an estimated rate.

Multiply successively by 0.2, calculate the sixth defect and compare it with 1e-5. Independently estimate q from adjacent history entries and ask a second investigator to check the iteration numbering and threshold comparison.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MITgcm：封閉水盒熱量與溫度增量驗證
related.titleEn: MITgcm: closed-water-box heat and temperature increments
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：雙事件驗證公式與標籤；長程採樣品質仍須獨立證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The two events validate arithmetic and labels; long-run sampling quality still needs independent evidence.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MITgcm：封閉水盒熱量與溫度增量驗證」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付熱容量推導、兩時間窗能量表、符號控制組與模型邊界說明。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MITgcm: closed-water-box heat and temperature increments using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver thermal-capacity derivation, energy tables for both intervals, sign-control cases and a model-boundary statement identifying the neglected transport and geometry effects.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算 exp(−1)，在零到一的線上標記接受區間與 u=0.5；將機率與一次事件分開記錄。
將熱通量乘面積得到 2000 W，再乘六十秒；逐步寫單位以排除 W 與 J 混用。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate exp(-1), mark its acceptance interval on a unit line and place u=0.5 on the same line. Record the probability separately from the realized decision so that one event is not confused with an estimated rate.

Multiply flux density by area to obtain 2000 watts, then integrate for sixty seconds. Carry units through both operations and explain why a power value alone cannot determine a temperature increment without duration.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
